newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt dips after strong German Ifo index.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt dips after strong German Ifo index.

text.p: Norwegian debt followed German Bunds down in light trade on Wednesday, but the 10-year yield gap versus Bunds remained at 69 basis points.

Chase Manhattan Bank in a market report said Forward Rate Agreements (FRAs) had come down to an attractive level, and recommended investors to buy contracts. "Levels should now be very attractive for buying FRAs unless one believes another rate cut is likely," the bank said.
Fokus Bank, the country's third biggest commercial bank, in a monthly report said it expected another rate cut just after Christmas.

Norway's Central Bank announced a 50 basis point rate cut on November 5 to prevent the crown from appreciating too much. The crown, which was volatile after the rate cut, was steady today around 101.7 against the European Currency Unit index.
